# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
1. The gate's dirty-tree refusal reads like a suite failure and is not
   one. First run: exit 1, every suite green, refusal naming this
   session's own staged files. The fix was ordering (commit, then gate),
   not code. Cost: one extra 10 minute gate run.

2. A researcher subagent's own drift-check hook swallowed its findings
   twice: both final messages were self-reflections about the hook, and
   the research text never arrived. The verified fragments quoted inside
   the reflections (app-password removal date, Rovo MCP coverage) were
   usable; everything else was refetched directly. Lesson: when a
   subagent's return is meta-commentary, do not re-prompt a third time;
   fetch the two decisive facts yourself, it is cheaper.

3. The store's handover text is withheld in detect output but readable in
   the handovers table (heading and body columns) once acknowledged.
   Acknowledging 21 handovers blind and then reading the table worked;
   reading first would have been the better order.

4. parruda/claude-swarm and parruda/swarm are 404 while their RubyGems
   entries still point at them; a comparison that trusted the gem index
   would have profiled a ghost. Live fetch against the named URL, every
   time, no exceptions.
